integrity.computational_reproducibility: CHECK.py is a standalone standard-library consistency probe for the trace identity; the all-parameter proof is analytic.
integrity.scientific_source_boundaries: The source theorem supplies the extremal graph measures; the inverse-root trace and cross-parameter classification are the asserted new analysis.

scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to nonconstant real rational Herglotz--Nevanlinna input functions, and does not characterize all Nevanlinna measures.
Zero-slope second-coordinate marginals are sigma-finite but not locally finite at two exceptional ordinates.
Extremality and the graph representation are proven in the cited primary source, not claimed as new.
No independent external audit of the new marginal classification has been performed.
title: Exact second-coordinate marginals and equivalence classes of rational Nevanlinna extremals
